totals.spine_source: SwitchCoal Finance Model workbook (SC_Europe_Sites_Copy) = GEM Global Coal Plant Tracker January 2023 release + SwitchCoal conversion model (T. Schmidt / Kapica model, Nov 2023). Economics carried 1:1 (SwitchCoal-Originalwerte).
totals.status_overlay_source: GEM Global Coal Plant Tracker, January 2026 release (Units sheet); joined per plant by coordinates (fallback name).
totals.scope_note: SwitchCoal Europe sites, excl. Türkiye (not in SwitchCoal's Europe sheet), excl. Russia. SwitchCoal counts/CO2 are GEM-2023 vintage and include plants closed since; see gem2026_status / availability per row. gem2026_capacity_mw is operating-only. A few rows with corrupt source economics or non-EU markets carry a data_quality note.
totals.currency_note: Investment & profit in SwitchCoal's original units (bn USD; profit over 30 years). Costs in ct/kWh as in the workbook.
